about_the_game:
Blurred Reality a first-person psychological horror experience that blurs the line between reality and the virtual world.

How dangerous can clicking a link really be?

On a stormy night… You’re sitting in your apartment when you receive a message from a friend: "You have to try this game." The link they send you leads to a game called Capcured. Curiosity gets the better of you, and you download and launch it…

GAME WITHIN A GAME

In Capcured, you play as an ordinary kid eager to earn your first paycheck by posting flyers on apartment doors. There’s just one thing left to do: reach the final apartment. But as you progress through the game, strange things start happening in your own apartment.

Soon, you can no longer tell the difference between the game on your screen and reality. Is this just a game? Or have you become part of something much bigger?

Features:

  • Indie Development: A passion project crafted by a single developer.

  • Game Within a Game: What starts as a simple task simulation turns into a nightmare that invades your reality.

  • Psychological Tension: A story filled with events that will trigger your paranoia and turn your mind upside down.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: A stormy night, echoing footsteps, flickering lights, and a presence waiting for you… A threat lurking around every corner.

  • A Single-Session Horror Experience: A roughly 1-hour journey that will keep you on edge every second.

Get ready… Because the game has already begun, and you don’t even realize it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: How dangerous can clicking a link be? "Blurred Reality" offers a psychological horror experience where the boundaries between reality and the digital world disappear, leaving you feeling unsafe even in your own home. So, do you dare to click that link?
